llm_fields.description: The scheme provides a financial incentive of ₹8 lakh to Scheduled Tribe couples from the Devadasi community who marry on or after 1 April 2019, with ₹3 lakh for the groom and ₹5 lakh for the bride, to promote social acceptance and reduce casteism.
llm_fields.eligibility: Both spouses must be residents of Karnataka, belong to the Hindu religion, have a combined annual income below ₹5,00,000, and one spouse must be from the Scheduled Tribe community. The marriage must have taken place on or after 1 April 2019 and be between an ST individual and a non‑ST individual or between two ST individuals. The application must be submitted within 18 months of the marriage.
